documents.text: Dental unit FD-1042 (model DC-300) at Klinik Sehat, Surabaya. 2024-03 service: suction motor failure; replaced the suction motor; resolved same visit.
Dental unit FD-1042 (model DC-300) service 2024-09: hydraulic leak on the chair; sealed the hydraulic line; resolved same visit.
Dental unit FD-1042 (model DC-300) service 2025-01: suction motor failure recurred, the third time; replaced the suction motor; resolved same visit.
DC-300 suction motor: recurring failure is usually caused by a clogged filter; check and replace the filter on every service to prevent repeats.
Main machine warranty is 2 years from installation; components are 1 year. The suction motor is treated as a component, so it is out of warranty after the first year.
Invoice INV-2023-118: dental unit serial FD-1042 (model DC-300) purchased 2023-06-15 for Rp 85,000,000; sold by sales rep Rina Putri; installed at Klinik Sehat, Surabaya.
Troubleshooting suction motor failure: the usual root cause is a clogged suction filter. Inspect and replace the suction motor to prevent a repeat visit.
Troubleshooting hydraulic leak on the chair: the usual root cause is a worn hydraulic seal. Inspect and replace the hydraulic seal to prevent a repeat visit.
Troubleshooting footcover cracked: the usual root cause is material fatigue on the footcover. Inspect and replace the footcover to prevent a repeat visit.
Troubleshooting low-speed water hose misrouted: the usual root cause is a split low-speed water hose. Inspect and replace the water hose to prevent a repeat visit.
Troubleshooting panoramic adaptor dead: the usual root cause is a failed S60 panoramic adaptor. Inspect and replace the panoramic adaptor to prevent a repeat visit.
Troubleshooting compressor overheating: the usual root cause is a blocked compressor filter. Inspect and replace the compressor filter to prevent a repeat visit.
Troubleshooting handpiece not spinning: the usual root cause is worn handpiece bearings. Inspect and replace the handpiece to prevent a repeat visit.
